title: Real Units: Hz, ms and note lengths
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: Knob values in real units. The filter's FREQ in hertz (as Filter Hz, which this replaces), the filter envelope's ATK, DEC, REL and DEL and the amp envelope's ATK, HOLD and DEC in milliseconds or seconds (INF at 127 where the stock never ends), and the LFO SPD and MULT pop-ups add the LFO's cycle length: bars, a note value or steps with the tempo, Hz free-running. Every number comes from the tables the sound engine itself uses.
